about_the_game:
Witch City Stories 

In a world ruled by ordinary men, magic is a gift possessed by only a few. Pipi, a young and inexperienced witch, is destined to face a cataclysm of planetary proportions, she must get rid of a meteorite and save all the beings that inhabit the planet. To do so, she must discover the right spell and gather the necessary elements to perform it. Will Pipi be able to save them all?

Break the Loop. Master the Magic. Change Fate.

Immerse yourself in a 2D visual novel set in an industrialized society of the 1980s, where magic exists but only a few can wield it. In this world of neon lights and dark secrets, you will play as Pipi, a witch descendant of the Mongoose clan, on a mission that defies fate: breaking the time loop that dooms humanity to relive the same cataclysm every five days.

Face crucial choices, uncertain alliances, and magical duels as you uncover the truth behind the families that control the world.

Will you balance the scales of power or be lost in the web of conspiracies?

Key Features:

  • Explore a vibrant and mysterious city, full of details where magic and technology collide.

  • Challenge the time loop and find the key to breaking it before the world resets again.

  • Master magic to interact with the environment, solve puzzles, and engage in witchcraft duels.

  • Forge your destiny by making choices that shape the story and lead to multiple endings.

  • Face the Serpent clan, a family willing to do anything to seize power.

  • Uncover unexpected twists, hidden secrets, and the true cost of magic.
